purpose: Painted open passages anchored exclusively to actual corridor mouths; solid walls and furnishing footprints remain authoritative geometry.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high quality hand-painted game architecture texture/sprite for a top-down shinobi fortress dungeon. Create ONE architectural wall-bound open passage, centered, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. It is a thick ancient grey basalt masonry opening: two narrow carved stone jambs joined by an elegant battered stone lintel, subtle worn bronze reinforcement, fine cracks and realistic chipped stone. View from a fixed steep overhead 70 degree orthographic game camera, horizontally level and perfectly symmetrical; believable detailed painted material and soft ambient occlusion. The CENTER and the bottom approach must remain TRANSPARENT, completely OPEN and WALKABLE. No door leaf, no steps, no rug, no floor patch, no props, no characters, no signs, no UI, no colored glow. This is a structural wall opening embedded in actual dungeon walls, NOT a freestanding door in the middle of a room. Tight framing, 8% transparent margin, clear silhouette, restrained charcoal slate and aged bronze, professional dark fantasy RPG environment art matching grey slate fortress floor. Jambs occupy only outer left and right 15 percent; the middle 60 percent is unobstructed transparent opening.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: professional hand-painted ancient cavern passage architecture for a top-down dark shinobi RPG. Create ONE natural rock opening into an ancient cavern, centered, isolated on genuinely transparent background. An asymmetric broken grey-green basalt arch with two narrow rough rock sides, mineral strata, wet fissures, sparse old roots, remnants of ancient small carved lintel stones; eerie weathered archaeological material, detailed painted texture and soft ambient occlusion. Fixed steep overhead 70 degree orthographic game camera looking slightly toward the north rock face, level horizon, exact centered open passage footprint. The CENTER and bottom approach remain TRANSPARENT and entirely WALKABLE; side rocks occupy only the left and right outer 15 percent, open middle 60 percent. No door leaf, no flat floor patch, no steps, no characters, no text, no UI, no glowing colored blocks. The rock opening belongs in an actual rock-wall boundary, never a standalone prop in a chamber. Tight framing, 8% transparent margin, restrained dark desaturated teal and mineral grey, no exaggerated magical light. Premium detailed fantasy cave environment artwork.

processing: Preserved generated alpha; trimmed transparent margins, normalized within 512 by 384 pixels, and encoded as WebP at quality 86 and alpha quality 100. Existing painted functional furnishing assets are reused at matching grid-aligned collision footprints.
